description: This CSS file contains style definitions for the theme management and layout of the interactive tic-tac-toe application. It defines variables for light and dark themes, styles for various components like App, App-header, and theme toggles, as well as animations and responsive design.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the application, styling includes text alignment, background color, and minimum height.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header component of the application, with styles for layout and background color.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styling for clickable links within the application.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button to toggle between light and dark themes, includes hover and active state styles.
